WITH phase_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    o.lunarstage,
    AVG(t.bandusagepct) as phase_avg_bandwidth,
    COUNT(*) as phase_telescope_count
  FROM telescopes t
  INNER JOIN observatories o ON t.observstation = o.observstation
  GROUP BY o.lunarstage
),
mean_of_averages AS (
  SELECT AVG(phase_avg_bandwidth) as overall_mean
  FROM phase_stats
),
kept_phases AS (
  SELECT 
    ps.phase_avg_bandwidth,
    ps.phase_telescope_count,
    ma.overall_mean
  FROM phase_stats ps, mean_of_averages ma
  WHERE ps.phase_avg_bandwidth > ma.overall_mean
)
SELECT 
  AVG(phase_avg_bandwidth) as avg_of_kept_averages,
  SUM(phase_telescope_count) as total_telescopes,
  AVG(phase_avg_bandwidth - overall_mean) as avg_excess
FROM kept_phases

assumptions.assumption: Phases with no telescopes holding non-null bandwidth values will have NULL phase_avg_bandwidth; these phases are automatically excluded from the mean-of-averages calculation and from the filtering step (NULL comparisons are falsy in SQL)
